created: 2026-10-16 (before any follow-up GPU run; B2 rerun still in progress)
status: post-hoc exploration: added after seeing stage A results

new_policies.P9: periodic by task step, k=3: router at attempt 0 of steps 0 and 3 only (retry turns never count or trigger)
new_policies.P10: event + periodic review: router if (turn==0) or (P6 event: [New task] at attempt 0, or non-PASS verifier on the message being answered) or (attempt==0 and step - last_router_step >= 2). At most one router call per turn; last_router_step = step of the most recent router call (any attempt).

note_P5: existing P5 counts turns (incl. retries), k=2; P9 counts task steps. Not the same counter.

rerun_check.purpose: timing drift check vs evalA; not an additional sample

initial_choice_diag.input: first request (turn 0), short context, cold cache (= the evalA state after per-run reset)

switch_diag.source: B2 rerun turns (P4,P6,P7,P8) where active=B and router chose A
switch_diag.selection: strata = (context, cache, policy group {P4/P7: every-turn, P6/P8: event}); within each stratum order candidates by sha256('20261018|'+session|policy|turn); take round-robin across strata in fixed order until 20 or exhausted. No outcome information used.
switch_diag.duplicate_rule: P7 and P8 points whose (session, context, cache, turn, prompt_sha) duplicate a P4/P6 point are dropped before selection (identical state).
switch_diag.restore: reset server -> replay, per model, the logged prompts that model received before this turn in this run (since its last eviction), max_tokens=1 -> settle -> measure; repeated per rep

do_not: change k, prompts, threshold after seeing results
